## 2025-05-22 - CSS Injection in Chart Component
**Vulnerability:** The `ChartStyle` component in `src/components/ui/chart.tsx` was vulnerable to CSS injection. It injected `id` and `ChartConfig` keys/colors directly into a `<style>` tag using `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.
**Learning:** Even internal-looking IDs (like those generated by `useId`) or configuration objects can be attack vectors if they can be influenced by user input or external data. `useId` in React can contain colons which might break unquoted CSS selectors.
**Prevention:** Always sanitize any data being injected into `<style>` or `script` tags. Use defense-in-depth: sanitize IDs, keys, and values, and use quoted attribute selectors to prevent breakout even if some characters slip through.
